candidates.detail: The studio checkbox selects a pose-corrective model. On a successful same-LOD reload, reload_model replaces BodyModel and marks the studio dirty, but StudioCache::body keys the generated body on LOD, proportions, identity and expression only. If those values are unchanged, it returns the old Arc without calling generate_character on the reloaded model, and does not clear dependent fit, lining or drape caches. A separate BareBody key includes the corrective flag.
candidates.native_boundary_and_safeguards: MhrConfig selects whether the corrective network is loaded; Mhr::forward adds its output to rest vertices only when a network exists. The creator fills only nine proportion model parameters and a successful joint_bases result requires their rotation/scale columns to be zero. CorrectiveInput reads joint rotation channels rather than translations; however the model transform can add authored offsets before feature extraction, and the actual asset offsets and network values have not been inspected. Thus source does not establish a nonzero corrective or a visible mismatch; successful reload, actual assets and device behavior are also not demonstrated. This narrows rather than resolves the historical policy question.
candidates.connected_scope: BodyModel reload, cache identity/invalidation, generated-body Arc and dependent armor, lining, drape and hair consumers, MHR transform offsets and corrective network inputs, with distinct bare-body and export paths.
candidates.proposed_repair: After audit completion, decide the owner contract: prove and document that corrective mode is equivalent for all supported cached body outputs, or include output-affecting model identity in the cache key and invalidate dependent caches coherently. Avoid claiming that the flag is necessarily output-affecting without asset evidence.
candidates.later_acceptance: When product validation is authorized, establish equivalence for supported asset/model configurations or verify same-LOD toggles refresh the body and its dependent geometry while preserving valid cache reuse. Include load-failure and no-network cases and the actual corrective inputs.
